title: Lucky Number - 2
description: Prints Lucky Number when N is a multiple of 9 or one of its two digits is 9.

data.question: Write a program that reads a two-digit number and prints "Lucky Number" when it is a multiple of 9 or either digit is 9, otherwise "Unlucky Number".

brief.summary: Prints Lucky Number when N is a multiple of 9 or one of its two digits is 9.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads a two-digit number and prints "Lucky Number" when it is a multiple of 9 or either digit is 9, otherwise "Unlucky Number".

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It tests N % 9 == 0 and also inspects the first and second characters for the digit 9.
